summary: On June 3, 2026, Wellington Investment Advisors Holdings, LLP (WIAH) announced a definitive agreement to acquire Hartford Funds Management Group, Inc. (HFMG) and certain affiliates from The Hartford Insurance Group, Inc. The transaction, approved by both parties, will integrate HFMG into Wellington's U.S. Wealth business, which oversees over $1 trillion in assets. After closing, the combined entity will be wholly owned by Wellington and operate under the Wellington name. The deal is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions. For the Lattice Strategies Trust ETFs, HFMC or an affiliate will continue as adviser pending Board and shareholder approval. What to watch: regulatory clearance and ETF shareholder votes.
